mapper.select: select agafd.id, dc.channel_id, dc.channel_name, dpufd.dates, dpufd.pkg, dpgfd.user_type, dpufd.login_user_num active_user_num, dpufd.register_user_num new_user_num, IFNULL(dprfd1.retention_user_num, 0) second_user_num, IFNULL(dprfd2.retention_user_num, 0) tertiary_uer_num, dpgfd.total_user_num minor_game_user_num, IFNULL(ROUND(dpgfd.total_user_num / IF(dpgfd.user_type = 0, dpufd.login_user_num, dpufd.register_user_num), 3), 0) minor_game_penetration_rate, IFNULL(ROUND(15 / dpgfd.total_user_num, 3), 0) minor_game_level_per_capita, dpgfd.total_grant minor_game_send_amount, dpgfd.grant_per_capita minor_amount_per_capita, dpgfd.game_time_per_capita minor_game_time_per_capita from dws_pkg_user_full_daily dpufd LEFT JOIN dws_pkg_retention_full_daily dprfd1 ON (dprfd1.dates = dpufd.dates and dprfd1.pkg = dpufd.pkg and dprfd1.register_day = 1) LEFT JOIN dws_pkg_retention_full_daily dprfd2 ON (dprfd2.dates = dpufd.dates and dprfd2.pkg = dpufd.pkg and dprfd2.register_day = 2) INNER JOIN dws_pkg_game_full_daily dpgfd ON (dpgfd.dates = dpufd.dates and dpgfd.pkg = dpufd.pkg and dpgfd.user_type = 0) LEFT JOIN dim_channel dc ON (dc.pkg = dpufd.pkg) LEFT JOIN ads_game_analyse_full_daily agafd ON (agafd.dates = dpufd.dates and agafd.pkg = dpufd.pkg and agafd.user_type = dpgfd.user_type) where dpufd.dates = #{dates}
